objective: Prepare a truthful local installation experience and complete public documentation without publishing a package or release.
acceptanceCriteria: The Apache-2.0 license text and package metadata are complete and consistent.
A locally packed tarball installs into a temporary directory and exposes the documented mv3replay command.
Documentation includes inspect, compare, JSON, errors, privacy, limitations, support status, and safe examples.
No npm publish, GitHub release, network telemetry, account, billing, or promotional claim is added.
npm package contents include only intended public runtime and documentation files.
All tests and the public-safety check pass.
stopConditions: The package would contain an unexpected file or identifier.
Three attempts fail on the same issue.
The exact Ox model is unavailable or rate-limited.
deliverable: Changed public files and compact JSON with tarball inventory, install-test result, documentation coverage, and blockers.
